entries.name: degrade-leak-coll99-accept#0
entries.description: Output 0's tree is size-flagged v3 (0b0ad1efefefefefefefeffd): BoolToSigmaProp, 8 LogicalNot, then unknown opcode 0xfd at depth 10. CheckValidOpCode throws a ValidationException, the tree degrades to UnparsedErgoTree, and the 10 levels are never lowered again (ErgoTreeSerializer.scala:209-211 restores only the position limit). Output 1 R4 = Coll^99[Byte] then takes 10 + 1 + 99 = 110. Round-trip identity.

entries.name: degrade-leak-coll100-reject#1
entries.description: The same tx with output 1 R4 = Coll^100[Byte]: 10 leaked + 1 + 100 = 111, rejected at parse. On a fresh level it would take 101 and parse (the blesser's control), so an impl that restores the level after the degrade round-trips the tx: the over-accept.
